title: Define and enforce the DNA serializer compatibility and legacy-migration policy
description: The serializer boundary needs an explicit compatibility policy for legacy verticalOffset migration and unknown JSON members. The earlier verticalOffset concern remains open for policy selection: FromLegacyOffset still clamps finite out-of-range legacy values before normal validation, which may silently repair malformed legacy data. This task should decide strict rejection versus explicit repair/reporting, then lock the decision with tests for valid endpoints and finite out-of-range values. Non-finite legacy offsets are no longer admitted: FromLegacyOffset now rejects NaN and Infinity at the migration boundary. Unknown JSON members likewise need an explicit open/closed/open-with-diagnostics compatibility decision. The raw-control-character writer defect is separately completed under TSK-0164 and is no longer part of this task.

comments.body: TSK-0164 now owns the CanonicalJsonWriter control-character implementation. This record retains only the still-unresolved legacy verticalOffset finite-range policy and unknown-field policy so task ownership is not duplicated.

comments.body: Safe partial hardening landed: CurveAdapter.FromLegacyOffset rejects NaN and +/-Infinity rather than producing a non-finite AnimationCurve. Finite values outside [-1,1] remain historically clamped until the compatibility policy is explicitly decided. Added CurveAdapterMigrationTests covering NaN, Infinity, and preservation of the finite clamp behavior.
